mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future S&P 500 cash flows and generating positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals persistent labor market weakness that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 5.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based slowdown in the real economy, which triggers a flight to quality and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO decline for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low industrial production (INDPRO < 115), supply chain disruptions cause input cost inflation and reduce corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 115, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the annualized rate of consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) over the past 3 months signals accelerating inflation, which compresses real equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 40% of periods where CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 2.0% annually, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and corporate cost pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has fallen below 5.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential sales (RSAFS) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a housing market correction that reduces consumer confidence and spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS rises and HOUST falls for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 115 for three consecutive months, it signals a deepening manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate investment and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 115 for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
